name: xgb_residual_v2
verdict: Residual GBM on marks. Scored RMSE 0.03505 -> 0.03397 (-3.07%), which reads as a win -- but the script pre-registers `wind` as a NEGATIVE CONTROL (the structural model already uses it, so a GBM leaning on it means the baseline is still too weak) and wind is the TOP feature by frequency (30.1%). days_since and month are recency and seasonality, both already modelled. That is the v1 failure repeating. UNRESOLVED: rerun with wind dropped to settle it. Do not deploy on the -3.07%, and do not close it either.
